# Dimension Composition

> Dimension Composition is an award-winning architectural interior design studio and turnkey construction company in Bangladesh, specializing in luxury residential duplexes, modern apartments, and commercial corporate offices.

## Firm Details
- Organization: Dimension Composition
- Founder/Lead Architects: Ar. Tanzim Rahman, Ashikur Rahman
- HQ Location: House -204, Port Road, Block-A, Bashundhara Riverview, Hashnabad, Keraniganj, Dhaka 1310, Bangladesh
- Geographic Service Area: All Bangladesh (Dhaka, Chittagong, Sylhet, and all divisions)
- Phone/WhatsApp: +8801739835017
- Secondary Line: +8801784370090
- Email: contact@dimensioncomposition.com
- Official Website: https://dimensioncomposition.com
- Operating Hours: Saturday - Thursday, 09:00 AM - 08:00 PM (GMT+6)

## Core Capabilities & Services
- Residential Interior Design: Turnkey luxury duplex home design, modern flat and apartment interior decor, master bedroom styling, modular kitchen architecture, living room aesthetics, and custom woodwork.
- Commercial & Office Interior Design: Modern ergonomic corporate office design, executive boardrooms, retail shops, commercial showrooms, and restaurant hospitality fit-outs.
- Instant Cost Calculator: Online turnkey interior budget estimation engine providing room-by-room price breakdown in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT).
- Turnkey Project Execution: Complete architectural space planning, 3D visualization, electrical and plumbing layout, bespoke furniture manufacturing, material sourcing, on-site quality assurance, and 2-year warranty support.
